title: Where the cold is felt
odia: ମାଘେ ଶୀତ, ମେଘେ ଶୀତ, ଯତ୍ର ବାତ ତତ୍ର ଶୀତ
literal_meaning: Cold in Magha, cold under clouds; wherever wind, there cold.
explanation: A rhythmic reply names occasions when cold is felt.
meaning_odia: କେବେ ଶୀତ ଲାଗେ ବୋଲି ପଚାରିଲେ ମାସ, ମେଘ ଓ ପବନକୁ ନେଇ ଏହି ଛନ୍ଦମୟ ଉତ୍ତର ଆସେ। ଅନୁଭବକୁ ଏକ ଲୟରେ ସଜାଇ କହିବାରୁ କଥାଟି ଶୁଣିବା ଓ ମନେ ରଖିବା ସହଜ। ଏହା ଦୈନନ୍ଦିନ ଅନୁଭବର କଥନ, ପାଣିପାଗ ବିଜ୍ଞାନର ସମ୍ପୂର୍ଣ୍ଣ ବ୍ୟାଖ୍ୟା ନୁହେଁ।
usage_example: Someone asks why the afternoon feels chilly; another replies with this saying. (New editorial example, not a collected quotation.)
cultural_context: The dictionary presents it as a reply. Its Sanskrit phrasing is retained; it is not a universal weather rule.
